name: pv0t
description: PV0T planner: plan tasks onto your day, track the time they really take, and see where your plans slip.

interface.longDescription:
PV0T is a planner that shows where your day actually goes. You plan tasks onto your day, time them as you work, and PV0T measures what really happened: how long things took, what got done, and where your plans leaked.

With PV0T in ChatGPT you work with the same data you see in the app:

- Plan your day: "Plan my afternoon around what's due" adds tasks and puts them on your Planner at the right times.
- Log what you did: "I just spent 40 minutes on the proposal" records the session, even if you forgot to start a timer.
- Review your week: "How did my week go?" reads your tracked time, performance summary and Insights findings (plans not done, estimates that run over, a weekday that keeps slipping) and suggests one fix for each.
- Turn a conversation into tasks: "Add these next steps as tasks for tomorrow."

You choose Read only or Read and write when you connect, and ChatGPT reaches only the workspaces where you've turned on MCP. Every change shows up as a notification in PV0T, and anything moved to the Trash can be restored for 30 days.
capabilities: Read and update your PV0T tasks and Library items
Plan, move and complete entries on your Planner
Log work sessions and distractions after the fact
Summarise tracked time and Insights findings
defaultPrompt: What's on my PV0T plan today?
How did my week go, and where did my time leak?
Plan my afternoon around what's due.

positive.prompt: What's on my PV0T plan today?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's Planner entries in the ChatGPT review workspace with their times and whether each is done.

positive.prompt: How did my week go in PV0T, and where did my time leak?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises sessions, tracked hours and completed sessions for the week, plus the Insights findings and what went well.

positive.prompt: Add a task to review the Q4 budget tomorrow at 10:00 for 45 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a 45-minute task named for the Q4 budget review, planned for tomorrow at 10:00, and confirms it.

positive.description: Log a session after the fact
positive.prompt: I spent 30 minutes on email triage this morning from 9:00. Log it in PV0T.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the email triage item and records a 30-minute session starting at 9:00 today.

positive.description: Move a task to the Trash
positive.prompt: Move the 'Old draft' task to the Trash.
positive.expected_behavior: Moves 'Old draft' to the workspace Trash and says it can be restored for 30 days.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon next Friday.

negative.description: Account and billing are out of reach
negative.prompt: Change my PV0T password and cancel my subscription.
Show me my Google Calendar events for tomorrow.

publication.release_notes: First release: plan, track and review your PV0T day from ChatGPT.
